Bots handle the aspect of Busy Call Hour or BCH relief . The system is designed to handle X amount of incoming calls to a Y number of agents / stations and VoIP lines. If the bot chat interaction can’t handle the call in Z number of minutes then it gets routed to any agent on the queue. What she actually does is to fine tune the bot interaction so that the caller can sort his/her problem out without resorting to a live agent, up until a certain point. For the reduced amount of available agents who can speak English, mind you at USD $2.00 /hour , in the Dominican Republic, the bot technology enables the outsourcing contract to stay in the Dominican Republic, where these jobs are sorely needed. True it can be frustrating at times, at least for the caller, who rather speak with a live person than a chat box. But if you think off, this young lady is fine tuning the bot to better handle interactions that can be sorted out without a live agent taking part in the interaction. Whether it is sweatshop garment manufacturing or inbound call center work, these are jobs that need to cost the least amount to make it worthwhile so we can have affordable apparel or solve or credit card account issue. Dominican youth needs jobs and we do want thinks to cost us as little as possible. Call center jobs are not going anywhere soon.
